redeemSteps: Open the game and wait until your character loads in.
Press the Codes button on the side of the screen.
Paste a code from this page into the box. Codes are case-sensitive, so copy them instead of typing.
Press Redeem. The reward shows up in your inventory right away.

codesFaq.q: Why is my code not working?
codesFaq.a: Most of the time it was typed by hand and one letter is off. Codes are case-sensitive, so use the Copy button. If it still fails, the code has probably expired.

codesFaq.q: How often do new codes come out?
codesFaq.a: Usually with each update or when the game hits a likes or visits milestone. This page is re-checked whenever the game updates.
